article.headline: C.J. Luster scores 22, UNC Wilmington beats Norfolk State 89-80
article.description: — C.J. Luster II’s 22 points helped UNC Wilmington defeat Norfolk State 89-80 on Saturday night.
article.linkText: C.J. Luster scores 22, UNC Wilmington beats Norfolk State 89-80

event.description: UNC Wilmington Seahawks @ Norfolk State Spartans

keywords: UNC Wilmington Seahawks @ Norfolk State Spartans
article.story: NORFOLK, Va. -- — C.J. Luster II’s 22 points helped UNC Wilmington defeat Norfolk State 89-80 on Saturday night. Luster shot 6 for 13 (4 for 10 from 3-point range) and 6 of 6 from the free-throw line for the Seahawks (5-1). Patrick Wessler scored 20 points and added 10 rebounds and five assists. Tahlan Pettway had 18 points and shot 6 of 10 from the field, including 3 for 6 from 3-point range, and went 3 for 3 from the foul line. Jahki Gupton led the way for the Spartans (2-5) with 26 points and two steals. Norfolk State also got 11 points and nine assists from Jordan Skyers. Bahsil Laster finished with nine points and four assists. UNC Wilmington took the lead 39 seconds into the game and did not trail again. Pettway led the Seahawks with 11 points in the first half to help put them ahead 43-36 at the break. Luster scored 16 points in the second half to help lead UNC Wilmington to a nine-point victory. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
